name: aurora-bridge
description: Bridge: a right-hand pane with a live heartbeat, a one-dot-per-tool-call activity timeline, the permission gate, subagents, the hottest files and a receipt for the last turn, all drawn in your own palette

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colours as a JSON object (bg, surface, raised, line, dim, faint, muted, fg, ok, warn, err, coral, ramp[], tool{}). Written by the rice's apply step; empty uses the built-in Ember colours

width.title: Width
width.description: Columns the pane asks for when docked (40-100)

animate.title: Animate
animate.description: on: the heartbeat moves (fast while Claude works, slow when idle). off: draw once per event

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (it seats from 144 columns; /bridge opens it at any width)

demo.title: Demo data
demo.description: Fill the pane with a made-up mid-session state, for screenshots
